inspection_order: Approved original, candidate hero, every candidate nine-view PNG individually; no predecessor images, construction prose or prior scores read before freeze.
judgment: Recognizable Bellback: strong bell, timber frame and stone-foot massing. Face remains a long broad planar brow mask with tiny slit eyes and a compressed muzzle; the pale forehead spikes and conspicuous tooth fan compete with the original's organic wooden predator face. Bell and framework stand tall and orderly, with a boxy side silhouette rather than the concept's irregular compact guardian weight. Faceting is broadly faithful. Separate teeth and closed geometry receive no intrinsic likeness credit.
blinding_limits: Candidate identity and target rubric were known; filenames visible. This is a single static concept with incomplete rear/side specification, not a fully blinded study.
